narrative_prose: Hector secured the brass baton, his grip tightening as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea intensified, twisting the landscape into erratic and treacherous ridges. The violent crackle of the magnetic storm filled his ears, overwhelming the distant roar of the sea below. He could smell the burning ozone, a stark contrast to the metallic tang on his tongue and the harsh, biting chill that seeped through his suit. Sensing the fluctuating pressure, Hector moved quickly to CONCEAL the critical datapad within his vest, attempting to DEFEND its fragile circuitry against the surging electromagnetic pulses that sought to CONSUME everything in their path. With the data secured, albeit precariously, he signaled Kaio, readying the handoff before the next wave could strike.
summary: Hector protects the datapad from the escalating magnetohydrodynamic shear before initiating the baton handoff to Kaio.
